definition_one_sentence: A customer account that placed at least one non-cancelled order in the 12 months before the report date.
formula_or_rule: count(distinct customer_id) from fct_orders where order_date > report_date - interval 12 month and order_date <= report_date and status <> 'cancelled'
example: Report date 2026-11-25: account 10328 ordered on 2026-07-17 (delivered) so it is active; ShopFast has 1080 active customers (Sales 6-month rule with cancelled orders gave 811).
notes_conflicts: Counted per account (customer_id), not per person: 52 emails are shared by several customer_ids, so one person can count twice. Sales wanted 6 months and Finance 12 months: the company term uses 12 months (board, year comparisons); the 6-month view is the separate term recently active customer. dim_customers.last_order_date includes cancelled orders and must not be used alone.

definition_one_sentence: A customer account that placed at least one non-cancelled order in the 6 months before the report date.
formula_or_rule: count(distinct customer_id) from fct_orders where order_date > report_date - interval 6 month and order_date <= report_date and status <> 'cancelled'
example: Report date 2026-11-25: account 10328 (last order 2026-07-17) is recently active; ShopFast has 775 recently active customers, all of them also active customers (1080).
notes_conflicts: Created for the daily Sales dashboard and the marketing campaigns (6 months = seasonal collections). Subset of active customer. Counted per account like active customer. Never call it active customer in a report.

definition_one_sentence: The money ShopFast keeps from an order once refunds are deducted, without VAT and with shipping fees kept in.
formula_or_rule: round((gross_revenue_eur - refunded_eur) / 1.20, 2) per order, summed over the orders of the period (VAT rate 20%)
notes_conflicts: Sales wanted VAT included (commissions are paid on amounts with VAT): that amount is gross_revenue_eur - refunded_eur (52628.43 EUR in October 2026) and must not be called net revenue. Both memos agree on deducting refunds. Hypothesis: flat 20% VAT for all countries.

definition_one_sentence: A customer account that placed at least one non-cancelled order in the past but none in the 12 months before the report date.
formula_or_rule: accounts whose most recent non-cancelled order_date <= report_date - interval 12 month; accounts that never ordered are excluded
example: Report date 2026-11-25: account 10017, last order 2025-10-16 (delivered), is churned; ShopFast has 145 churned customers.
notes_conflicts: Built as the complement of active customer among accounts with at least one non-cancelled order, so the two counts never overlap. Target of the churn prediction model and the retention campaigns. Counted per account.

definition_one_sentence: An account registered on ShopFast and identified by one customer_id, whether it has ordered or not.
example: 1241 raw rows - 8 exact duplicate rows = 1233 customer accounts, of which 15 never ordered.
notes_conflicts: One person can have several accounts (52 shared emails, 53 shared name + birth date). Personal data: classification confidential. 14 orders point to a customer_id that does not exist.

definition_one_sentence: A purchase placed by a customer account at one date on one sales channel, identified by one order_id, whatever its status.
formula_or_rule: count(distinct order_id) from stg_orders; status in (pending, shipped, delivered, cancelled, returned)
example: 5207 raw rows - 7 duplicate order_ids = 5200 orders, of which 434 are cancelled and 263 returned. Order 700236 of account 10328 on 2025-06-18 is delivered for 424.50 EUR.
notes_conflicts: Cancelled orders are still orders but do not make a customer active. 11 orders have no order_date and 5 are dated in the future.
